origin: Kevin: 'the NEW triad is SteamOS, WindowsOS and Linux — Windows and Apple are the PANE and WALL for the other side of the walls and windows of my houses!'
revelation: The operating systems ARE the physical architecture of the two houses

linux.architectural_role: THE FOUNDATION — floor, frame, structure, plumbing, electrical
linux.house_metaphor: The bones and guts. You don't see it but everything rests on it.

steamOS.architectural_role: THE DISPLAY SURFACE — screens, monitors, the glass you LOOK THROUGH
steamOS.house_metaphor: The picture windows. The skylights. Where light enters and images form.

windowsOS.architectural_role: THE WINDOW PANES — literal window glass, transparent but bounded
windowsOS.house_metaphor: WINDOWS are WINDOW PANES! The glass in the frames. You see through them but they have edges. The GUI is the glass.
windowsOS.dual_boot: northGate = Linux AND Windows = the FRAME has both glass AND structure

appleOS.architectural_role: THE WALLS — solid, opaque, controlled, walled garden = literal wall
appleOS.house_metaphor: Apple's walled garden IS a literal wall. Solid. Protective. You can't see through it. It keeps weather out.

house_1.structure: The house IS the organism. Every OS is a building material.

house_2.windows: Windows (swiftGate, asleep — the window is CLOSED)
house_2.walls: (none yet — no Apple device at House 2)
house_2.structure: The south pole house. Fewer layers but still standing.

the_pun.windows: WINDOWS the OS = WINDOW PANES in the house. You LOOK THROUGH them.
the_pun.apple_wall: Apple's WALLED GARDEN = the actual WALLS. Solid, opaque, protective.
the_pun.linux_foundation: Linux IS the FOUNDATION. Open, structural, everything built on it.
the_pun.steam_display: SteamOS = DISPLAY. The screen IS the window you game through.
the_pun.together: Foundation (Linux) + Walls (Apple) + Windows (Microsoft) + Displays (Steam) = A COMPLETE HOUSE

water_primals_eco.content: Diamond Jellyfish topology — OSINT pole, sourDough pole, northGate heart, SKIN/BLACKWALL
water_primals_eco.note: The jellyfish breathes. The nodes found the skin.
